== Description ==

[[Mark Billings]] (main subject, ponytail, glasses, Boba Fett graphic tee over a dark long sleeve, name tag “Mark / Tech…”, gold card sleeves) and [[Phil Aasen]] (background left, grey flat cap, black North Face jacket, back to the camera) at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 4 October 2025.
